quest.title: Promise You Won't Waste Your Youth
quest.description: A shared hobby brings you all together...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've still got some gas in the tank.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Awesome! Then let's get back to it. Whew, the next section looks even harder...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Let's make sure to stay alert so we don't leave the course, and pace ourselves to protect our joints... That's what Coach Iansan would say. Her advice is always spot on!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey Varesa, we finished reading that comic book you gave us. It was pretty cool!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Morning... Wait, you finished it? Wow, that was so quick!

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Hehe, so you, too, have been won over by Fietena's infectious charisma... It was but a matter of time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: From what we read, it seemed like the Soulblazers were a group of Natlanese heroes who fought against monsters.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also, Mavuika had a cameo in there. Does that mean The Soulblazer Saga is based on historical events?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: That's right. It's an adaptation of Natlan's history. All the characters are based on real people.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: But of course, it's mostly for entertainment. You can't treat it as a history textbook.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: The Soulblazers were warriors who fought against the monsters of the Abyss. Their mission? To protect their nation.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: The finest warrior of all the Soulblazers was Fietena. She is our hero, our role model.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: The Pyro Archon has some real cool fight scenes too though! She fights with real passion!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: But there's a whole bunch of other comic series that deal with her story specifically. This one is more focused on Fietena's story arc — her motivations, her rise to greatness, and so on.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: No matter how desperate things got, she never lost hope.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Thanks to her dogged determination, she went from rookie warrior with no understanding of strategy to a formidable commander... Along the way, she became friends with a group of fellow warriors who stuck with each other through thick and thin...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Ah, Fietena! She's my hero!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This story really means a lot to her...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: She seems truly inspired.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Oh, every time my thesis gets rejected, I just think about all the challenges that she faced... and suddenly, my own problems don't seem so insurmountable after all.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Don't worry, Alrani, I have faith in you! You'll get your thesis approved one day!

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Aw, Varesa...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Hm, you bet I will! Trifling thesis, you are no match for me! When I get back to the Akademiya, prepare to be whipped into shape.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Sooo... Now that you guys are into the series, you wanna join the Legion?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... What does it involve? It's a comic book fan club, right?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Don't stress over it. Yes, we were initially brought together by a shared interest in comics.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: But ultimately, our main purpose is to share life's joys and get rid of life's woes.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Whatever comes our way, we have each other, and we can face it together.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: We discuss comics together, eat together, and chill together.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In that case, Paimon's in!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Count me in too.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: YES! Welcome, welcome!

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Captain, what about the welcome ceremony? Or have you forgotten our traditions?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Haha, of course I haven't forgotten! Find a nice open space and wait for me there — I'll just go grab something from the camp.

choices.text: I want to understand the whole story.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Here, this is a good spot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alrani, do you have any idea what Varesa's fetching from the camp?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Probably the relic we use to swear in new members.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Relic?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I'm here! Hope I didn't keep you waiting too long? I sprinted the whole way!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Here, take this. It's a Fietena mask, I made it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thanks! ...Huh? Isn't this the mask you wear in combat?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: That's right. Fietena used to wear a mask in combat too, so the one I made for myself is modeled after hers.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Um... Mind if I keep going for a bit?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not at all! The floor is yours.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: ...Phew.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: The tale of The Soulblazer Saga is a long one, told over 12 volumes. The characters go through so many changes along the way, growing and developing as the story progresses.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: This mask, for instance, is just one of the five different versions Fietena wears during the story. This one is my favorite of them all.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: At one point, Fietena goes through a tough phase where she's disillusioned after fighting so many battles. But her friends are always there for her even through her darkest time.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: With their encouragement, she was able to rally and get back on her feet... And this is the mask she wore when she made her comeback.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: In my view, that makes it the perfect relic to use for inducting new members into the Legion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, this ceremony just got super ceremonious!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hehe! Hold onto it, you're gonna need it during the ceremony!

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Oh! Captain, is it time?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: #Now, {NICKNAME} and Paimon, join me in reciting the Legion of Soulblazers' creed, which we will cry out at the top of our lungs...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait... We have to shout it out?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yeah! Just imagine you're bursting with praise for the chef after a sensational meal.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Or... for me, sometimes, I get so happy hanging out with my friends that I just wanna shout "thank you" as loud as I can.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: When you believe in something, you shout it for the whole world to hear!

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Exactly. I couldn't have put it better myself. Now, repeat after me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: O—Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Through pain and defeat, we shall never fear!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Through pain and defeat, we shall never fear!

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I will always champion love and imagination!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I will always champion love and imagination!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Great! Soulblazers, as of this moment, you are now members of the Legion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Haha, I can't wait to tell Xilonen the good news!

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: If I'm not mistaken, she's out training with Minnie and Yigang today.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Got it. Alright, let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: *panting*...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Yigang
dialogues.text: ...Vice Captain, shall... shall we call it a day?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: That's enough strength training for now, but we still have racetrack familiarization training. We can't afford to skip it.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: #Attention, Soublazers! *fanfare* It gives me great pleasure to introduce two new additions to the Legion of Soulblazers: {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, induction complete! Now we're officially Soulblazers.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Ah! Welcome to the club. Unfortunately, I don't think we'll be able to hold a welcome party for you today.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Minnie and Yigang have been training for ages. They're completely exhausted.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Con... Congratulations...

response.speaker: Tang Yigang
response.text: Minnie... You still up for... racetrack familiarization training?

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Yeah... Why... Why wouldn't I be?

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Since... since it's a... four-person relay, we... we gotta... rehearse every stage...

response.speaker: Tang Yigang
response.text: I'm so jealous of Alrani... logistics is the easiest job... gets to stay at the camp the whole time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, they seem totally wiped out... Alright, we can skip the welcome party! We pretty much know everyone anyway.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Shame you have to miss out though, I feel kinda bad. Lemme think... Ah! Okay, here's what we'll do!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Why don't you join us for training? We still need to practice on the race course itself, so we could turn it into a team-building event.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: In this cold weather, there's no better feeling than running around and getting the blood pumping. We'll all feel toasty and warm by the time we're done!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #What do you say, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: C'mon, it'll be fun! We can chat while we train, it'll take your mind off it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... Count Paimon out, she is not cut out for this at all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's never run a day in her life, 'cause she can fly! Flying's way faster than running.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Hehe, is it now... Hmm, we should race sometime, put that theory to the test.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... no thanks! Paimon flying is faster than Paimon running, not Varesa running!

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Alright, we'll let Paimon off. It would be pretty absurd having someone who can fly join a running race.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: I'm all rested up, so I can join you instead.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: As for Minnie and Yigang... If you guys wanna keep training, then pace yourselves and stick to slow jogging. But if you're worn out, feel free to stay put and recover.

response.speaker: Tang Yigang
response.text: Thank you, Vice Captain. Yeah, I'm not moving... I'll just rest right here.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: I'm down to keep training.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: #Okay, that makes four of us for training. Me, Varesa, Minnie, and {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Let's split into two groups then. Xilonen and Minnie can do a slow jog, I'll be sprinting full speed on the race course.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, you join whichever group you want. We're just happy you can join us.

choices.text: Get those legs moving for once?
I will always champion love and imagination!

talks.objective: Head to the start of the track

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go back and meet up with Minnie.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Okay! Then let's call it a day.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Once we've rested up... How about we go take a walk through the city this afternoon?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: This track forms part of the official race course. It's one of the flatter sections.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Monsters, huh... I guess that makes sense. Mountains have plenty of places for wildlife and wild monsters to hide.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I'll politely ask them to leave us alone...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: There were some monsters up ahead, but I chased them off. They won't affect the training.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: How's it going? You two holding up okay?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I'm good. Minnie's form is so much better than last time.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: *coughing* ...I still think... I need more practice...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: The course goes into an uphill climb from here. It's gonna get pretty tough.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: It's fine... I'll keep going... I gotta get a good ranking. I don't wanna drag the team down.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Even so, you shouldn't push yourself too hard. Health and safety always come first, results are second.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Thanks, Varesa... I do appreciate it, but the thing is...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: You need this, don't you? For personal reasons.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: You mentioned some kind of deal with your parents? I'm guessing it's something to do with that.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: I noticed you had a certain look on your face when you first brought it up, like you were trying to suppress how you were feeling.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: In my view, when a kid makes a face like that, it's actually a cry for help.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: So what's really going on? You can tell us. If you keep it to yourself, we can't help you fix it.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Um... I remember Minnie saying in one of her letters how she hoped to go to Inazuma one day and work as an assistant comic book artist.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: That, or become a prop maker, building true-to-life comic book items for fans.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: But her mom and dad aren't very supportive of her goals... Could that have anything to do with the relentless training?

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: ...O—Okay, I'll explain...

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Varesa's right. My mom and dad don't approve of me moving abroad for work.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: I'm the baby of the family. There's a huge age gap between me and my older brother, and I was a pretty sickly child, so my parents worried a lot about me growing up.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: They don't like the thought of me moving so far away from home. They say they'd always be worrying about my health.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Also, they'd rather I pick something more stable. The idea of trying to make a career in the comic book industry is crazy to them. They think I need to be more realistic, get a "real job."

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: But what employable skills do I even have? I can do art, and I can build stuff, but I'm no good at anything else.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't be so hard on yourself.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: It's like, no matter how many times we have the conversation, I can never get through to them. They treat me like I'm just a little kid, living in a fairytale world.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: But this time, the situation is different. Suddenly, my friends came all the way to Mondstadt to see me, because of our shared interest in comics.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: And then we signed up for a cross country contest. That really surprised them... I'm sure they don't believe I can do it.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: So I made a deal with my parents: If I pull this off and my team gets ranked, they have to start taking me seriously about what I want in life.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Don't worry, Minnie, you're in good hands! Even Coach Iansan has praised me for how fast I can run, and she has high standards!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: And you've seen Xilonen when she gets going, right? She's as tough as they come, a real hero. She fought wars for her tribe!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: As long as we do well enough to get ranked, your parents will come around, right? I'm confident we can do that! We're all behind you on this.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Varesa...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Minnie, I still remember that time you sent Nepecha some of your work. Artwork of Fietena, and a mask you built yourself.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: She showed them off to all the other kids in the tribe, and they loved them so much, they offered Mora to buy them off her. But Nepecha wasn't about to let go of them.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Huh? R—Really? I had no idea anyone would wanna pay for my artwork...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Why wouldn't they? Your creations have real value. And while that's subjective in emotional terms... Heh, the offer of Mora's a pretty objective measure.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: To me, that fact alone says that you already have a "real job."

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Your mask and artwork are already famous in the Collective of Plenty! People are constantly asking, "Who painted this? It's incredible work!"

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: If you ever visit our tribe, you can bet there'd be crowds of people swarming you and begging for your autograph!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: I'll definitely visit one day! I... I had no idea I had fans already...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: All in good time. We can talk more about that later — for now... I think you need to stay here and get some rest.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Thanks, both of you. I'll make sure to rest properly.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Good. I'll stay here and keep you company for a while.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #{NICKNAME} and I will keep training then. Might as well finish out the track.

choices.text: Why don't you take a rest, Minnie?

talks.objective: Clear the monsters from the track

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Phew, glad that's taken care of. One less thing for Minnie and Xilonen to deal with.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: They're jogging the same course as us right? They should be here any minute.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Let's wait for them.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: How's it going? You two holding up okay?

choices.text: Why don't you take a rest, Minnie?

talks.objective: Advance toward the Statue of The Seven

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Whew! We made it to the relay point of section two. That's today's training target officially smashed.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: We just need to check out sections three and four of the course, but we can do that tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Huh, now that we've stopped, it suddenly occurred to me... After a whole morning of running, we're still only halfway up the mountain.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Kinda...? But then again, I'm already freezing, and it must be even colder up at the top... Hmm...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: ...Yeah, forget it, let's head back. I'll catch a cold if I'm out here much longer.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Why don't we regroup with Xilonen and Minnie, then head back together?

choices.text: You wanna climb to the summit?

talks.objective: Go back and regroup with Minnie and others

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hey, you two, we're back.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Three, actually — Yigang came to join me and Minnie while you were out training.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Yigang
dialogues.text: Yeah, I felt bad slacking off while everyone else was going the extra mile... Achoo.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Sounds like the cold's getting to you.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Alright, let's head back to camp so people can get some extra layers on.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Wow, the time's really flown by... At this rate, I don't know if I'll have time for my nap before we hit the city for the afternoon.

talks.objective: Return to the camp and meet up with everybody else

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Well done on your training, everyone. Now, we have some free time before this afternoon's activity.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: As planned, we'll meet by the Knights of Favonius headquarters at 2:00 PM.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Will we get to go to the library? Will we, will we?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: That's right! Excited?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Yes!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Yigang
dialogues.text: Me too. After days up here in the mountains, I'm looking forward to finally checking out the city.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Great! In that case, see you all at 2:00 PM sharp for some well-earned fun!

dialogues.speaker: Both
dialogues.text: Yeah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That perked them up! Now that fun's on the agenda, they don't seem so tired anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Well, of course. It's important to relax and de-stress after training hard.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hehe, and to eat! I am suuuper hungry right now... Okay, everyone, dismissed!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: We made it to the relay point. Good job!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I gotta say, this terrain is seriously challenging. If people don't familiarize themselves with the course in advance, they could easily get lost on race day...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: But at least the organizing committee has taken the time to clearly mark out the course. And thankfully, there aren't many wild animals or monsters out here. People should be able to practice without incident.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: How are you feeling? Still got the energy to keep training?

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Phew... I... I need a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: It's okay, I got her. You keep training.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Minnie, your baseline fitness is still limited. Don't go full throttle right out the gate, okay? Start slow and steadily build up your speed.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Okay, keep your head up, shoulders back, and allow your arms to swing however feels natural. You'll save energy that way.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: This is the second section of the official race course. Watch out for signs so you stay on track.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: You definitely don't wanna stray off course on a mountain like this. It could get dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: If you find yourself getting cold, there are some torches off to the side in this section. Just set one alight and warm yourself up.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: There's a gap here. If we jump down, it should shave a lot off our race time.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: But it's a little risky. Gotta be careful not to sprain an ankle, or it's game over...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Watch out for that pit. Don't fall in.
